help.title: CSN Bhoomi Help & Support
help.subtitle: Simple guide to using your agricultural platform
help.step1Desc: Go to "My Farms", click "Add New Farm", locate your village or survey number, and draw your field boundary to verify your exact acreage in acres and hectares.
help.step2Desc: Click "Soil Health" in the menu or on your farm card. View estimated N, P, K, pH, and organic carbon with ICAR ratings.
help.step3Desc: Click "Farming Assistant" to discover which crops best suit your soil and season, along with fertilizer bag schedules (Urea, DAP, Potash).
help.step4Desc: Go to "My Reports" to generate and download printable PDF reports with field maps and nutrient tables.
